Subject: Deployment mode assessment — PoC action plan & success metrics

Hi Sarah / Tim —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we scope a PoC: 

Summary of constraints you called out:
- Data residency: PHI-adjacent telemetry must remain in us-east region and ideally within your VPC for audit controls.
- Latency: sub-150ms 95p for short inference paths (token lengths ~200).
- Cost predictability: preference for committed pricing vs variable per-token for production.

Redwood deployment options matched to those constraints (high-level):
- Hosted API: fastest onboarding; falls short on residency / customer-managed keys.
- Dedicated capacity: predictable throughput and private GPU pools; can be co-located in preferred region; supports tighter SLAs.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full network isolation and KMS/HSM integration; higher ops lead time.

Proposed 3-week PoC (recommendation: Dedicated in us-east to validate throughput & residency controls, with a parallel evaluation of VPC peering feasibility):
1) Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): exchange minimal test dataset, confirm region and test VPC endpoints.
2) Week 1–2: run steady-state load tests (QPS/latency), KV/prefix cache validations, sample failure scenarios.
3) Week 3: quality checks against your prompt set + measurement of cost per 1M tokens.

Success criteria (draft):
- Latency: 95p inference <= 150ms for 200-token requests.
- Throughput: sustain X rps (you to confirm target; I used 60 rps in the cost estimate).
- Data controls: logs & audit trail accessible to HealthScribe SOC team; evidence of regional data egress controls.
- Cost: model/config achieves <= $Y per 1M tokens (see attached estimate).

Owners / asks from HealthScribe: please confirm the desired throughput target (rps) and whether Private VPC is a blocker vs. a later phase.

I've attached a PoC checklist and the estimated Dedicated costs for accelerated sizing. If that looks good we can spin up a quick canary pool and schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff Wednesday.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah —

Short answers up front: Dedicated in us-east can be provisioned in a tenant-isolated pool and we can enable region-restricted storage for logs and KV cache. For customer-managed keys (CMK) you have two options:

1) Dedicated + Bring-Your-Own-KMS (BYO-KMS integration): we support envelope encryption with a CMK in your cloud account for certain Dedicated packages; this typically requires a short security review (2–4 business days) and a config change on our side.
2) Private VPC (full tenancy): provides the tightest control for audit/HSM-based workflows but has a longer lead time (2–4 weeks) and a different commercial cadence.

For the PoC we recommend starting with Dedicated + BYO-KMS if you want faster time-to-evidence. That will let us validate performance and cost; if that passes, we can move to a Private VPC pilot before production.

Proposed PoC technical plan (short):
- Provision a 4-card GPU canary pool in us-east (48 hours).
- Run synthetic load to validate 95p latency and p99 tail under your prompt set.
- Run a small parallel run where logs are exported to a HealthScribe-managed bucket to validate residency and retention controls.
- Weekly checkpoints (Wed) with a short dashboard we’ll send you.

Attached: quick sizing and cost workbook. I also attached the notes from our internal technical sync.

If that aligns I’ll create a mutual action plan doc and a short SOW template for Tim.

Ben
Director, Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference
